tex_content.html:
\begin{exercise} \end{exercise}1. ch4:4-8Suppose $M$ is a smooth manifold (without boundary), $I \subseteq \mathbb {R}$ is an interval (bounded or not, with or without endpoints), and $\gamma : I \to M$ is a smooth curve.

(a) Show that for every $t_0 \in I$ such that $\gamma '(t_0) \neq 0$, there is a connected neighborhood $J$ of $t_0$ in $I$ such that every smooth vector field along $\gamma |_J$ is extendible. \end{exercise}
